text: This discipline attaches great importance to academic exchanges and actively carries out international academic exchanges and cooperation. Well-known foreign experts and scholars are often invited to give lectures at the school, and experts and professors are often invited to visit and give lectures abroad, and young teachers are sent abroad for further study. In recent years, it has become increasingly active in exchange visits and academic activities with scholars from France, Canada, the United States, Japan, Germany and other countries. It has maintained close cooperative relations and regular personnel exchanges with well-known foreign universities such as Lille University of Science and Technology, Vanache University, Klaimon-Ferrand University, Kyoto University in Japan, Nagoya Institute of Technology, Berlin University of Applied Sciences in Germany, University of Pittsburgh in the United States, Chunti University in the Netherlands, etc., and sends visiting scholars and advanced students to each other. Extensive academic exchanges and cooperation enable the discipline to timely learn from and absorb advanced technological achievements and school-running experience at home and abroad, which plays a very important role in accelerating the pace of discipline construction, improving the academic level and self-quality of teachers, and making the quality of talent training in this discipline, and at the same time expanding the prestige of the international academic community.
